description: Agent Market: find the paid tool for a capability across ~35,000 x402 endpoints (Bazaar index, refreshed weekly). Ranked by match, then real 30-day usage (calls, unique payers); filter by max_price_usd and network; exclude= a vendor to get substitutes (tool down or rate-limited); the top picks are probed live (never paid) for status, price and drift. Capability Finder, Procurement Desk, Quote Comparator, Tool Substitute Finder and Rate-Limit Router in one call. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: GET https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/market/find, $0.002 via x402.)
name: market_find
